# Parallel processing mine
```{r parallel processing}
# Setup Parallel Processing with 20 Cores
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(BiocParallel)

# Detect the number of available cores
cores <- min(20, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)) # Use 20 or available cores, whichever is smaller
print(paste0("Number of cores available: ", cores))

# Configure future plan for multicore processing
plan("multisession", workers = 20)  # Linux/Unix systems
# plan("multisession", workers = cores)  # Windows systems

# Set memory and seed options for reproducibility
options(future.globals.maxSize = 60 * 1024^3)  # 60 GB memory limit
options(future.seed = TRUE)

# Set up BiocParallel (optional, used in some functions)
#bpparam <- MulticoreParam(workers = cores) # Parallel backend for Bioconductor functions

```
# **Install and Load Required Libraries**
```{r libraries ravis}
# Set memory limit for Java and reproducibility seed
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx30000m")
set.seed(100)

# List of required packages (from CRAN and Bioconductor)
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "patchwork", "Seurat","DT","ggplot2","Polychrome","future","future.apply","BiocParallel","UCell")

# Function to suppress both messages and warnings
suppress_all <- function(expr) {
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(expr))
}

# Install and load missing packages quietly
install_and_load_packages <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    suppress_all(tryCatch({
      install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
        suppress_all(install.packages("BiocManager"))
      }
      suppress_all(BiocManager::install(package))
    }))
  }
  suppress_all(library(package, character.only = TRUE))
}

# Apply the function to install/load required packages
invisible(lapply(required_packages, install_and_load_packages))
```

# Dotplot before annotation
```{r dotplot, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}
DotPlot(data_obj, features = features_test_s4a) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

# dotplot for every cell type markers from S20
# Generate and store the plots
# For loop to create DotPlots for all groups in features_test
#features_test <- lapply(features_test, function(x) x[x %in% rownames(data_obj)])

# List to store plots
plot_list <- list()

# Generate DotPlots
for (group in names(features_test)) {
  markers <- features_test[[group]]
  
  if (length(markers) > 0) {
    plot <- DotPlot(data_obj, features = markers, assay = "integrated") +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +  # Ensure consistent axes
      ggtitle(paste("DotPlot for", group)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    plot_list[[group]] <- plot
  } else {
    message(paste("No valid markers for group:", group))
  }
}

# Combine and print plots in pairs
for (i in seq(1, length(plot_list), by = 1)) {
  p1 <- plot_list[[i]]
  #p2 <- if (i + 1 <= length(plot_list)) plot_list[[i + 1]] else NULL
  
  #combined <- if (!is.null(p2)) print(p1 + p2) else print(p1)
  print(p1)
}
```

Merged clusters visualised 
```{r,eval = FALSE}

levels(Combined_hpa)
# View the metadata

cluster_labels_m <- levels(Combined_hpa)

# Generate a color palette with the same number of colors as there are clusters
cluster_colors_m <- Polychrome::createPalette(length(cluster_labels_m), c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))

# Assign each color to a cluster name
names(cluster_colors_m) <- cluster_labels_m

# Generate the UMAP plot with custom colors
DimPlot(Combined_hpa, reduction = "umap") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors_m) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP with merged clusters")
```

# Comparision with Ravi's annotation
```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2,eval = FALSE}
obj_ravi_processed <- readRDS("/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/20200122_10x_frog_tail_regeneration/20220817_new_genome/data/processed/seurat_integrated_sctmark_ravi.rds")

#updating my barcodes to match Ravi's
rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data) <- gsub("_1", "-0_hpa_B", rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data))
rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data) <- gsub("_2", "-1_hpa_B", rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data))
rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data) <- gsub("_3", "-3_hpa_A", rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data))
rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data) <- gsub("_4", "-12_hpa_A", rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data))

# Check if the rownames now match
length(intersect(rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data), rownames(obj_ravi_processed@meta.data)))

# Add the identities to the metadata
Combined_hpa@meta.data$my_annotation <- as.character(Idents(Combined_hpa))

ravi_meta_data <- obj_ravi_processed@meta.data

Combined_hpa$ravi_annotation <- ravi_meta_data$cell_type_final[match(rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data), rownames(ravi_meta_data))]

comparison_df <- Combined_hpa@meta.data %>%
  group_by(my_annotation, ravi_annotation) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(my_annotation) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = my_annotation, y = proportion, fill = ravi_annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Ladislav's Annotation", y = "Proportion", fill = "Ravi's Annotation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Comparison of Annotations")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Seurat clusters correlation
```{r,eval = FALSE}
Combined_hpa$ravi_seurat_clusters <- ravi_meta_data$seurat_clusters[match(rownames(Combined_hpa@meta.data), rownames(ravi_meta_data))]
#TO DO
comparison_df <- Combined_hpa@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, ravi_seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = proportion, fill = ravi_seurat_clusters)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Ladislav's Clusters", y = "Proportion", fill = "Ravi's Clusters") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Comparison of Clusters")
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
